draft.title: How to season a cast iron pan
draft.metaDescription: Seasoning cast iron, step by step.
draft.intro: Heat the pan to 260°C and apply flaxseed oil in six thin coats, each baked for two hours. Cast iron must never touch soap, and a single wash with detergent will strip a seasoning built over years.

sections.heading: The method
sections.body: Six coats at 260°C is the standard used by professional kitchens. Anything less will always flake within a month.

sections.heading: Care
sections.body: Never use soap. Never use a metal utensil. A cast iron pan cannot be soaked, cannot be washed in a dishwasher and must be dried immediately.
